detaileddescription.para: High temporal locality - prefetch to L1 cache Use for: hot data, imminent access within ~100 cycles
Moderate temporal locality - prefetch to L2 cache Use for: data accessed soon, within ~1000 cycles
Low temporal locality - prefetch to L3 cache Use for: data that may be reused, accessed within ~10000 cycles
Non-temporal - bypass cache hierarchy Use for: streaming data accessed once, no reuse expected

Controls which cache level to prefetch data into:
T0: Temporal data with high locality (L1 cache) - most aggressive
T1: Temporal data with moderate locality (L2 cache)
T2: Temporal data with low locality (L3 cache)
NTA: Non-temporal data (bypass cache) - for streaming workloads
